Definition: Kirjath-Jearim or Kirjath-Arim, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Kirjath-jearim = "city of forests"; 1) a city on the northern boundary of Judah and on the western and southern boundaries of Benjamin; 1a) also 'Kirjath-baal' and 'Baalah'
